market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. Fed hike risk, diesel inflation, and geopolitical escalation (Houthis, Ukraine drones) create headwinds. AI regulatory debate adds volatility. Bessent's bond market loss pressures equities. Expect 3-5% pullback in high-multiple growth. Energy and defense outperform. Watch for Fed meeting reaction.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI infrastructure demand (HPE, networking) and Boeing recovery support structural growth. However, 5%+ yield environment and energy inflation cap multiple expansion. Healthcare consolidation (J&J/Apollo) and consumer resilience (Ulta, KO) offer steady returns. Dot-com comparison is premature but warrants vigilance on AI valuations.
